Rainy Night Walk 🌙☔️✨ Color with me in The Cozy Collection by Coco Wyo! For this page I’m only using markers from the Coco Wyo × Ohuhu collab set, plus a white gel pen for the finishing highlights. I wanted the streetlamp to be the focal point, so I kept the nighttime areas cool with blues and purples and switched to brighter, warmer colors wherever the light hits. I also added a soft rainbow reflection across the wet fence and used white highlights at the end to make everything feel shiny after the rain. 🌈✨ One thing I’m trying to share more in these videos is why I choose certain colors and where I place them, instead of only showing the finished page. What part of my coloring process would you want me to explain more in the next one? 💗 #cocowyo #thecozycollection #ohuhumarkers #adultcoloring #colorwithme
